Game Overview

Mangavania puts players into a fighting experience centered on embark on a daring journey through the perilous Underworld alongside Yuhiko, a nimble ninja on a quest to save his brother. Traverse pixelated realms, wielding sword and spirit to outsmart monsters. Master precision platforming, uncover secrets, and unlock new paths in this captivating action-adventure.
